hook.en: No pump pushes oxygen into your blood. It simply moves from where there is more of it to where there is less — by diffusion. Partial pressure is the "height" of that hill.
hook.kn: ಯಾವ ಪಂಪ್ ಕೂಡ ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕವನ್ನು ರಕ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇರುವಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ವಿಸರಣದಿಂದ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡವೇ ಆ ಇಳಿಜಾರಿನ ಎತ್ತರ.

narration.en: No pump pushes oxygen into your blood. It simply moves from where there is more of it to where there is less — by diffusion. Partial pressure is the "height" of that hill.
narration.kn: ಯಾವ ಪಂಪ್ ಕೂಡ ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕವನ್ನು ರಕ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇರುವಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ವಿಸರಣದಿಂದ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡವೇ ಆ ಇಳಿಜಾರಿನ ಎತ್ತರ.

body.en: The pressure contributed by one gas in a mixture is its partial pressure: pO2 for oxygen and pCO2 for carbon dioxide. Gases diffuse from higher to lower partial pressure. Alveolar pO2 is 104 mm Hg while deoxygenated blood has 40 mm Hg, so O2 enters the blood; tissues have pCO2 45 mm Hg against 40 in oxygenated blood, so CO2 leaves the tissues. Solubility also matters: CO2 is 20–25 times more soluble than O2, so far more CO2 diffuses per unit difference in partial pressure.
body.kn: ಮಿಶ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಅನಿಲದ ಪಾಲಿನ ಒತ್ತಡವೇ ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡ. ಅನಿಲಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡದಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ವಿಸರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಂಗಾಲದ ಡೈಆಕ್ಸೈಡ್ ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕಕ್ಕಿಂತ 20–25 ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕರಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: The pressure contributed by one gas in a mixture is its partial pressure: pO2 for oxygen and pCO2 for carbon dioxide. Gases diffuse from higher to lower partial pressure. Alveolar pO2 is 104 mm Hg while deoxygenated blood has 40 mm Hg, so O2 enters the blood; tissues have pCO2 45 mm Hg against 40 in oxygenated blood, so CO2 leaves the tissues. Solubility also matters: CO2 is 20–25 times more soluble than O2, so far more CO2 diffuses per unit difference in partial pressure.
narration.kn: ಮಿಶ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಅನಿಲದ ಪಾಲಿನ ಒತ್ತಡವೇ ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡ. ಅನಿಲಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡದಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ವಿಸರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಂಗಾಲದ ಡೈಆಕ್ಸೈಡ್ ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕಕ್ಕಿಂತ 20–25 ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕರಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Gases cross a very thin diffusion membrane made of three major layers: the thin squamous epithelium of the alveoli, the endothelium of the alveolar capillaries, and the basement substance between them. Its total thickness is much less than a millimetre, so all the factors in our body favour diffusion of O2 from alveoli to tissues and of CO2 from tissues to alveoli.
body.kn: ವಿಸರಣ ಪೊರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ಪದರಗಳಿವೆ: ಗಾಳಿಗೂಡಿನ ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ ಎಪಿತೀಲಿಯಮ್, ಲೋಮನಾಳಗಳ ಎಂಡೋತೀಲಿಯಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ತಳಪದಾರ್ಥ. ಇದರ ದಪ್ಪ ಒಂದು ಮಿಲಿಮೀಟರ್‌ಗಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

problem.en: Using the NCERT table, explain the direction of O2 and CO2 movement (a) at the alveoli and (b) at the tissues.

steps.en: Alveoli: pO2 104 mm Hg vs deoxygenated blood 40 mm Hg — O2 moves from alveoli into blood.
Alveoli: pCO2 40 mm Hg vs deoxygenated blood 45 mm Hg — CO2 moves from blood into alveoli.
Tissues: pO2 40 mm Hg vs oxygenated blood 95 mm Hg — O2 moves from blood into tissues; pCO2 45 in tissues vs 40 in blood — CO2 moves into blood.

answer.en: At the alveoli O2 enters and CO2 leaves the blood; at the tissues the reverse happens, each gas going down its partial-pressure gradient.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Using the NCERT table, explain the direction of O2 and CO2 movement (a) at the alveoli and (b) at the tissues.

heading.en: Remember the table with two numbers

body.en: Oxygen-poor places (deoxygenated blood and tissues) are always 40/45 for O2/CO2. Oxygen-rich places are 104/40 in alveoli and 95/40 in oxygenated blood. Only the atmosphere is extreme: 159/0.3.
